title: ISA launches the 2026- 2027 campaign for the International Day of the Deep Seabed
DISCOVER – Advance and celebrate the discovery and description of deep-sea biodiversity and the people and institutions contributing to that knowledge.
SHARE – Strengthen access to data, samples, scientific expertise and capacity, and help connect knowledge through scientific networks and platforms.
USE – Highlight how scientific knowledge can support environmental management, technological innovation and informed decision-making.
